en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 桌面端聊天和群聊新增区域截图与标注工具，支持自定义全局快捷键，并适配 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 截图方式 (#3312)
- 修复截图遮罩异常后聊天窗口无法恢复的问题，截图结束或失败时恢复原有窗口状态 (#3318)
- 新建聊天记住上次选择的 Agent，刷新后也能恢复选择 (#3320)
- 收藏和最近使用的工作区目录按账号保存，可在不同浏览器中继续使用 (#3317)
- 修复编程 Agent 使用 vLLM 等 Chat Completions 接口进行流式调用时缺少 Token 用量统计的问题 (#3314)
- 改善 Hermes 聊天重连后的状态恢复，修复完成或停止后仍显示运行中的问题，并确保排队消息继续执行 (#3321)
- 修复 Linux 桌面端开机自启，并完善桌面启动失败时的错误提示与诊断信息 (#3307、#3308)
- 移除群聊中已过时的升级提示 (#3306)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.32，前端更新日志补齐 11 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3323)
What's Changed
- [codex] remove group chat upgrade notice by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3306
- [codex] make Linux Open at Login register desktop autostart by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3307
- [codex] preserve desktop backend startup errors by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3308
- [codex] add desktop screenshots, platform support and global shortcuts by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3312
- [codex] persist workspace history and favorites by account by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3317
- [coding-agent] request stream usage from Chat Completions providers by @WenhuaXia in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3314
- [codex] isolate desktop screenshot failures by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3318
- [codex] remember the last Agent selected for new chats by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3320
- [codex] fix Hermes run state recovery and finalization by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3321
- [codex] prepare Studio 0.7.32 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3323
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.31...v0.7.32
